recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No core FHIR source follow-up is needed unless a future OO decision reopens the ServiceRequest.supportingInfo datatype.
issue_request: FHIR-37355 was a Published, Persuasive OO R5 change request to change ServiceRequest.supportingInfo from Reference(Any) to CodeableReference(Any), voted 4-0-0 on 2023-01-30.
initial_application: The Jira application comment points to PR 2589 commit 8a93ae8, but the actual source-changing commit in that PR lineage was e9c8a9961a7614db9d4326afb6000fadb72653e1, which changed source/servicerequest/structuredefinition-ServiceRequest.xml from Reference to CodeableReference before PR 2589 was merged as 5002c3c46d0888a555875dd5088c59996bdbf377.
additional_context: ServiceRequest is active in source/fhir.ini, and CodeableReference with targetProfile Resource is the source representation of CodeableReference(Any). Earlier FHIR-25552 asked for the same ServiceRequest-specific outcome and was audited opportunistically. FHIR-25554 bounded the broader Request-pattern proposal as no-change, and later FHIR-31589 clarified adjacent guidance without changing the datatype.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit because the current source and final combined branch already contain the requested CodeableReference(Resource) type for ServiceRequest.supportingInfo.

related_jiras.note: Earlier OO issue asking to add CodeableReference to ServiceRequest.supportingInfo; audited separately in this run because the same current source state satisfies it.

Later OO clarification of supportingInfo versus orderDetail; already reconciled on the combined branch.
